description: A splintered dock crate shoved against the wall, stenciled SUMP HOUSE STOCK — DO NOT WALK OFF WITH. Inside, a jumble of foam-wrapped slag orbs gone grey with handling, each one dense enough to sit you down and soft enough that you get back up. A hand-lettered card taped to the lid reads: FIRST ROUND OF THE NIGHT IS FREE. EVERY ROUND AFTER, YOU EARNED IT.
name: a crate of slag orbs
